tours.name: Finance: Reconcile Transactions Using Reconciliation Models ( Setup - Bank Charges Button - Invoice Match ) - Full Flow

name_i18n.en_US: Finance: Reconcile Transactions Using Reconciliation Models ( Setup - Bank Charges Button - Invoice Match ) - Full Flow

tours.description: For new users. Shows where reconciliation models live, how to read an existing invoice-matching rule, how to build a Button to generate counterpart entry model for monthly bank charges, and how to use both kinds of model on real Commercial Bank statement lines through to Validate.

steps.title: Auto-validate
steps.content: When Auto-validate is ticked the rule reconciles the bank line on its own, so you never see it in the Reconcile screen. Leave it off if you want to review each match first.

steps.content: Conditions decide when the rule fires: here the bank line label must contain SO, the amount must be within the payment tolerance and the currency must be the same.

steps.content: Use a BUTTON model for recurring costs with no invoice (bank charges, interest, small differences). Use a RULE to match invoices/bills for customer receipts and supplier payments. Use a RULE to suggest a counterpart when part of the line is a fee. Practice on the remaining lines - there is still a Monthly Bank Charges line of -25.00 and a Cheque Settlement - AAA Trading line of 2,800.00 waiting.
